messages:
oncall-bot: Pager: KV cache eviction spike on prod-us-west-2 cluster — elevated OOM/alloc failures observed. Priority: P1. Thread: kv-cache-fanout-surge-field-ops

sara_oncall: I'm looking. Seeing a cascade of cache growth on batch nodes, continuous-batcher queues ballooning. Metrics: per-node kv_cache_size rising ~4x over baseline in 2m.

ryan_runtime: attaching quick telemetry snapshot (snip):
```
node_id=usw2-batch-17 kv_cache_bytes=23.1GB (baseline 6GB)
continuous_batch_queue_len=812 (norm < 50)
cuda_malloc_failures=12/min
p99_latency_textgen=2.4s (norm 180ms)
```

marta_reliability: Confirmed. Eviction thread can't keep up, allocator fragmentation rising. Looks like slab churn + huge prefix growth from recent reranker change. Any recent deploys to batching?

james_se: I pushed a minor reranker tweak 30m ago that increases prefix caching of tokenized contexts for stream reuse. Might be correlated. Reverting now if needed.

sara_oncall: Hold on revert, trying soft mitigations first. Can we throttle continuous-batcher? What's the config key?

ryan_runtime: continuous-batcher tunables: batcher.enabled, batcher.max_tokens_per_batch, batcher.max_batch_size, batcher.prefetch_window. We can flip batcher.enabled=false via runtime config for a subset of nodes.

infra_bot: Running canary change: disable continuous-batcher on 2 nodes in usw2-batch pool (usw2-batch-17, usw2-batch-18).

oncall-bot: Change applied to canary nodes at 1718245980. Monitoring 5m.

sara_oncall: Good. Also bump eviction aggressiveness: kv_cache.eviction_pressure=1.5 -> 2.5 on canary.

ryan_runtime: Applied eviction pressure change to canary at 1718246020.

cs_amy: Heads up from CS: CanvasAI reports model responses failing intermittently around 1718245900; they have spike in 429/500s and high p99. They're on shared batch pool.

marta_reliability: Noted customer impact. Marking incident tag: kv-cache-fanout -> customer-visible.

james_se: I started a rollback of the reranker prefix-caching change at 1718246100.

ryan_runtime: Canary metrics look promising: kv_cache_bytes on canary nodes dropped to 8.3GB within 3m, queue_len down to ~40, cuda_malloc_failures -> 0.

oncall-bot: Canary success. Recommendation: rollout disable continuous-batcher across usw2-batch pool (gradual 25% -> 100%).

sara_oncall: Rolling to 25% now. Patch id: rb-171824.

infra_bot: 25% rollout applied at 1718246300 (6 nodes). Telemetry will be noisy while in progress.

marta_reliability: Watch eviction churn and fragmentation metrics during rollout. If allocator arena reslice increases, pause.

ryan_runtime: Observed allocator fragmentation metric "arena_frag_ratio" spike at 1718246460 on two non-canary nodes after initial 25%. Might be earlier CUDA malloc fragmentation manifesting when batcher disabled on large fraction.

sara_oncall: Pause rollout at 25% while we validate.

james_se: Rollback of my reranker change completed at 1718246520. Should reduce prefix-cache churn in ~1-2m.

cs_amy: CanvasAI reporting errors falling but still elevated p99 until 1718246600. They're asking for ETA.

marta_reliability: ETA: incremental stabilization in 5-10m if no new allocation spikes. Communicate that to CS.

cs_amy: Sending update.

ryan_runtime: New observation: fragmentation seems tied to arena growth on nodes hitting >16GB allocations. We're seeing repeated CUDA mmap/munmap patterns; suspect pytorch/cuda allocator not returning memory back to OS quickly.

sara_oncall: Can we trigger arena compaction on the affected nodes? What's the control?

ryan_runtime: There's an internal trigger: gbench/arena_reclaim() can be signaled via /api/admin/allocator/compact on runtime agents. I'll run it on the six rollout nodes and the two bad nodes.

infra_bot: Triggering allocator compaction on nodes: usw2-batch-03, -07, -12, -17, -18, -21 at 1718246780.

oncall-bot: Allocator compaction completed across targeted nodes at 1718246860.

ryan_runtime: Post-compaction metrics: arena_frag_ratio down, kv_cache_bytes reduced ~20% on those nodes, cuda malloc failures gone. Good signal.

marta_reliability: Given compaction success and reranker rollback, propose resuming rollout but using a different path: instead of fully disabling batcher, reduce batcher.max_tokens_per_batch to 1024 and lower prefetch_window to 1 to avoid long-lived KV prefixes. Safer than flip.

sara_oncall: Agreed. We'll apply the conservative config to 50% then 100%. Patch id: cb-171824-b.

infra_bot: Applying conservative batcher config to 50% at 1718247000.

james_se: Also adding a temporary memguard: kv_cache.max_entry_age=600s to limit prefix retention.

oncall-bot: Configs applied at 1718247080. Monitoring.

ryan_runtime: Metrics trending positive: continuous_batch_queue_len back to normal, p99 latency improving toward baseline. No new malloc failures.

cs_amy: CanvasAI confirms error rate returned to normal. They requested a short RCA for CS.

marta_reliability: We'll draft an incident summary after stabilization. For now: impact window ~1718245800-1718247000 (approx 20m), primary cause: interaction between recent prefix-caching change and continuous-batcher behavior leading to KV prefix explosion and allocator fragmentation -> cuda malloc failures and elevated p99. Mitigations: canary disable, eviction pressure bump, reranker rollback, allocator compaction, conservative batcher throttles, memguard.

sara_oncall: Night oncall (ryan) will monitor for 2 more hours and follow up in #postmortems. Handoff: ry an_runtime (night) takes next watch.

ryan_runtime: Taking it. Leaving runbook checklist:
- watch arena_frag_ratio and cuda_malloc_failures
- confirm kv_cache.bytes < baseline*1.5 cluster-wide
- verify no regressions in throughput for high-traffic tenants

marta_reliability: Please schedule a postmortem, include: timeline, exact config deltas (git diffs), allocation traces from affected nodes, and a proposed permanent fix (e.g., backpressure in prefix cache + allocator-aware batching).

sara_oncall: Filed incident ticket INC-2026-342 with summary and mitigation steps. Will attach logs and metrics to the ticket.

cs_amy: Notifying CanvasAI w/ incident summary and SLA credit assessment.

oncall-bot: Incident moved to monitoring state at 1718248000.

sara_oncall: Any outstanding action items?

james_se: I will prepare a small revert-safe refactor for prefix caching that caps cached prefix growth by token count.

ryan_runtime: I'll add an allocator compaction hook to the autoscaler to trigger when arena_frag_ratio > 0.6.

marta_reliability: I'll own the postmortem and timeline.

sara_oncall: Good. Wrapping up the thread. If anything spikes, ping with @oncall.

oncall-bot: Thread closed for now; re-open if new alerts occur. Last update 1718248700.
